policy_amendment.algorithm_preservation: User explicitly requires baseline algorithms/functionality, including Siri swipes, unless explicitly changed; see AGENTS.md.
policy_amendment.executor_cec_boundary: Executor owns button state and all message choices without outgoing-frame buffers; CEC mechanically sends supplied frames/attempts/guards through its sole eight-total-message FIFO per wire, counting queued and active work. Releases have no extra slot; a full-FIFO release is dropped permanently without executor admission retry. Every TX dropped because the FIFO is full is logged, including each frame of a rejected atomic batch.
policy_amendment.keys: State changes only across devices, successful completion-paced repetition at owner, one attempt per UCP. Failed TX ends that key; late up is a NOP. UCR has no key operand and is implicit at recipient stream end only when all its keys cease being pressed, including last-key failure.
